name: Rollin 20s Crips
description: The Rollin 20s Crips (RTC) are a Crip set based on the East Side of Long Beach, California. Their territory runs primarily south of 21st Street, east of Long Beach Blvd, and west of Orange Ave. Members are known to wear black and gold, sporting Pittsburgh Steelers and New Orleans Saints gear as gang identifiers. The gang is internationally known in part due to its association with rappers Snoop Dogg, Nate Dogg, and Daz Dillinger.
